inputs.original_text: Revelation was included in lawsuit challenging practice of targeting people seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts Sign up for the Breaking News US email to get newsletter alerts in your inbox Lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts, according to newly filed court documents. Federal prosecutors said that lawyers for ICE acknowledged that an agency memo from May of last year gave no authorization for the arrests, court documents show , despite previously citing it to justify the arrests. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text:
They want us to believe this is just some routine legal slip-up, but look closer at the real coordination happening behind the scenes. According to the court documents, lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts. And what was their excuse? They previously cited an agency memo from May of last year to justify the arrests, yet federal prosecutors now admit that this very memo gave no authorization for the arrests at all. 

Don't buy the official narrative that this was accidental incompetence. This was a calculated, systemic operation to target people seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts. The revelation came to light in a lawsuit challenging this exact practice, exposing how the machinery of the state operates under a cover story while executing the hidden agenda of the elites.
